name: tenant-jwt-authorizer
description: API Gateway HTTP API Lambda REQUEST authorizer: verifies Keycloak JWTs, maps issuer -> tenant, injects X-Tenant-Id/X-Role/X-Party-Id context. See docs/aws-api-gateway-lambda-authorizer.md.

scripts.build:console-zip: rm -rf dist-console tenant-jwt-authorizer.zip && mkdir dist-console && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist-console/index.mjs && cd dist-console && zip -q ../tenant-jwt-authorizer.zip index.mjs
